title: Musical Instruments
hook: 阁楼里翻出一箱旧乐器，一人一件，家里立刻热闹得不行。

cells.q: What had Mummy and Daddy Pig been doing?
cells.a: They had been tidying the house all morning.
cells.cn: 他们整理了一上午的房子。

cells.a: They were a bit old and dusty.
cells.cn: 这些乐器有点旧，还落了灰。

cells.a: She asked, “Mummy, can I play the violin?”
cells.cn: 她问：“妈妈，我可以拉小提琴吗？”

cells.a: She showed him how to hold the violin.
cells.cn: 她教 George 怎么拿小提琴。

cells.a: It was Daddy Pig's old accordion.
cells.cn: 那是猪爸爸的旧手风琴。

cells.q: What did Peppa say about the accordion?
cells.a: She said it is almost as difficult as her drum.
cells.cn: 她说手风琴和她的鼓一样难。

cells.q: What do you have to do to play it?
cells.a: You have to blow it very hard.
No. Peppa said it was impossible to play.
cells.cn: 没人会，Peppa 说根本吹不响。

cells.q: What did George do at the end?
cells.a: He blew the horn and made a big sound.
cells.cn: 他吹响了号，声音特别大。

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: violin, drum, accordion, horn, blow, difficult
helper.actions: tidy, find, hold, play, blow, laugh

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Musical Instruments”.
ending: In the end, George blows the horn and everyone is surprised. My favourite part is ______.
